news.title: What Will Politics Look Like on Other Planets? It's Likely to Be a Mishmash
news.description: When we make our home on other worlds, who will be in charge? Will it be an emperor? A billionaire? A rebel alliance? Or none of the above? Astrobiologist Jacob Haqq Misra runs through the legal and political options.

news.title: Spaceflight research opens new avenues for studying rare pediatric diseases
news.description: Earth-based hiPSC models have transformed disease research but remain limited by cellular immaturity, a strong reliance on glycolysis rather than oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS), and incomplete tissue architecture.
